name: bank
assumptions: Rattan frame simplified to rectangular members: each side frame is a front post, back post, armrest and low stretcher; side frame width (113 - 103) / 2 = 5 cm.
Curved rattan seat and backrest modelled as flat slabs; backrest leans from the seat rear edge to the top rear corner.
Armrest top at 620 mm, stretcher at 150 mm, member section 40 mm, seat slab 40 mm, backrest 30 mm (not dimensioned, estimated from the drawing).
The seat front edge is flush with the front posts.
ambiguities: 41 cm is drawn at armrest height from the backrest to the front post; read as seat depth, it could also be the armrest length.
103 cm is drawn diagonally in perspective; read as the clear width between the side frames.
58 cm is measured at the floor between splayed legs; the model has vertical posts, so the full depth is used at every height.
Overall height 84 cm is taken as the top of the backrest; the curved top roll is flattened.
